_comment: TIGHT tap-ordering test. Board = 1 Mountain (ONLY red) + 1 Unclaimed. Hand = only {1}{R} rituals (no pure-{R} Rite). To combo, Pyretic Ritual #1 MUST be cast with Unclaimed paying {1} via {C} and the lone Mountain paying {R}. If the solver wastes the Mountain on the {1} generic, Pyretic #1 is unpayable -> no combo -> no win. PASS(win) => ordering correct even with scarce red.
